verdict: The share card is information-rich (index state, viewers, stats) and redirect-mode permission handling is careful. The main gap is that editing a gallery's folders does not re-index it, so the gallery shows stale folder stats until the nightly job; the same expiry-drift-on-save bug as drop links exists here, and 'Unique viewers' silently caps at 50.

findings.title: Start an index job when a gallery share's folders change
findings.scenario: Admin opens Edit on a gallery share, adds a second Drive folder and saves.
findings.consequence: patchShare stores the new folderIds but neither plans an index job nor marks the stats pointer needsReindex; the new folder's tile shows no counts or cover and nothing is warmed until the nightly cron walks it, and the card still says 'Indexed 3 h ago' as if current.
findings.fix: When destinationChanged && share.mode === 'gallery', call planShareIndex(env, ctx, share, { trigger: 'edit', full: true }) and ctx.waitUntil(runShareIndexChunk(...)) exactly as createShareRecord does (patchShare needs ctx passed from the router).

findings.title: Only send expiresDays when it was edited
findings.scenario: A share closes in 1 day 2 hours; the admin opens Edit to change the welcome text and saves.
findings.consequence: The editor pre-fills ceil(remaining days) = 2 and always sends it, so each unrelated save pushes the close date out by up to a day - a gallery meant to close on Friday stays open.
findings.fix: Store the pre-filled se-days value on open and include expiresDays in the PATCH only when the input differs.

findings.title: Stop presenting a capped viewer list as 'Unique viewers'
findings.scenario: A share is opened by 120 signed-in guests.
findings.consequence: bumpShareStat keeps only the 50 most recent viewer emails in viewers_json, so the card's 'Unique viewers' reads 50 and never grows; the admin under-reports the audience.
findings.fix: Keep a separate viewer_count column incremented when viewerPreviouslySeen is false and expose it as viewerCount; keep the 50-entry map only for the chips.

findings.title: Keep the preview-runner and orphan-sweep buttons in one tab
findings.scenario: Admin clicks 'Run now' for RAW previews in the Pipelines tab.
findings.consequence: The same data-run-share-previews handler runs, and six seconds later it rewrites that button's label to 'Make RAW previews'; the two tabs also show the same maintenance actions with different wording, so it is unclear which is canonical.
findings.fix: Remove both buttons from the Shares pane head (Pipelines owns background jobs) and link to Pipelines instead; have runSharePreviewsNow restore the button's original text captured at click time.

findings.title: Report failed pause / sign-in / archive / delete
findings.scenario: Admin pauses a share whose link leaked while the session cookie has expired.
findings.consequence: The PATCH returns 401 and the card redraws unchanged with no message; the admin believes access is cut.
findings.fix: Check r.ok and flash the error on the clicked button, as in the drop links fix.

missing_features.title: Open the gallery from the card
missing_features.why: Copy, QR and Share exist, but checking what the guest sees means copying the URL and pasting it.

missing_features.title: Per-share activity chart
missing_features.why: 'Did the client look at it after I sent it on Monday?' needs opens by day, which day_stats already records under share:<slug>.

missing_features.title: Download count on the card
missing_features.why: stats.downloads is computed and sent but only the byte total is shown.
